# Mem0

Mem0's memory layer: an LLM extracts facts from conversations, recalled by hybrid search, optionally reranked.

## Options

| Option | Values, default in bold | What it sets | Versions |
|---|---|---|---|
| `embedder` | **`text-embedding-3-small`**, `text-embedding-3-large` | The embedding model Mem0 indexes and searches with; Mem0's default is text-embedding-3-small. | every version |
| `infer` | **`on`**, `off` | Whether Mem0's LLM extracts facts from each session (`on`, Mem0's default) or the messages are stored as they are (`off`). | every version |
| `reasoning_effort` | **`default`**, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high` | How much reasoning the model uses before answering, with `default` leaving the choice to the provider. | every version |
| `rerank` | **`off`**, `llm` | Whether search results are reranked by Mem0's LLM reranker, with the run's model (`llm`); Mem0 does not rerank by default. | every version |
| `threshold` | `0`, **`0.1`**, `0.3`, `0.5` | The lowest score a memory needs to be returned; Mem0's default is 0.1. | every version |
| `top_k` | `5`, `10`, **`20`**, `50` | How many memories a search returns at most; Mem0's default is 20. | every version |
